title: session.rules_delivered@1
description: The rules and start slice a session was given (#344): at its start, at a prompt that carries a new set (a rule you typed, a compaction, a resume), or as a scoped rule's notice at its first call inside the scope. Only the core appends it; a rollback, a configuration eval or a judgment of a rule credits the set it names.

subject.description: The session the rules were given to.

writer.description: Only the core appends this kind.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

x-closure.closed: each value is a moment the hub gives a session rules, and judging a rule reads which
x-closure.reopens: a new major of this schema

via.description: How they were given: in the start slice, with a prompt, or as one scoped rule's notice.

pos.description: The log position the delivered rules and start slice were read at.

items.description: A rule's or slice entry's handle, such as wiki:rules#<id>, rule:<id>, slice:<name> or decision:<id>.
